experimental_method: Analytical flash technique: liquid (hydrate-free) samples withdrawn from a high-pressure crystallizer at constant pressure into an evacuated sample bomb, gas evolved into a gasometer, propane moles from the gasometer volume with Z from the Trebble-Bishnoi equation, and x1 by mass balance with the room-temperature solubility.
uncertainties_stated: Maximum absolute average deviation from the mean of replicate experiments 4.6 %; pressure transducer reference accuracy less than 0.065 % of span (0 to 13789 kPa); gasometer accuracy 0.2 % of reading. No temperature uncertainty stated.
quality_remarks: Authors compare the hydrate-free points with the Carroll and Chapoy correlations (Table 2): deviations -8 to +11 % (Carroll), -5.7 to +12.9 % (Chapoy). Table 1 gives mean values of replicates; individual replicates not tabulated. Experimental method uses the room-temperature solubility literature value for the mass balance.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2 (journal p. 1451): comparison of the six hydrate-free x1 (repeat of Table 1 values) with calculated values and percent deviations from the Carroll and Chapoy correlations: derived/model comparison, measured x1 already in Table 1
